+import types
+
+import toolz
+import tlz._build_tlz as builder
+
+
+def test_slow_only_public_exports_are_added(monkeypatch):
+    fast = types.ModuleType('cytoolz.audit', 'fast docs')
+    slow = types.ModuleType('toolz.audit', 'slow docs')
+    fast.__package__ = 'cytoolz.audit'
+    slow.__package__ = 'toolz.audit'
+    slow.__file__ = 'slow.py'
+    fast.shared = object()
+    slow.shared = object()
+    fast.fast_only = object()
+    slow.fallback = {'items': [1, 2]}
+    slow.alias = toolz.pipe
+    slow._private = object()
+    slow.preexisting = object()
+    owned = types.ModuleType('toolz.audit.child')
+    owned.__package__ = slow.__name__
+    slow.child = owned
+    foreign = types.ModuleType('outside.child')
+    foreign.__package__ = 'outside'
+    slow.foreign = foreign
+    mirrored = types.ModuleType('tlz.audit.child')
+    modules = {'cytoolz.audit': fast, 'toolz.audit': slow,
+               'tlz.audit.child': mirrored}
+    calls = []
+
+    def resolve(name):
+        calls.append(name)
+        return modules[name]
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(builder, 'import_module', resolve)
+    target = types.ModuleType('tlz.audit')
+    marker = object()
+    target.preexisting = marker
+    builder.TlzLoader().exec_module(target)
+    assert target.fallback is slow.fallback
+    assert target.alias is toolz.pipe
+    assert target.child is mirrored
+    assert target.foreign is foreign
+    assert target.shared is fast.shared
+    assert target.fast_only is fast.fast_only
+    assert target.preexisting is marker
+    assert not hasattr(target, '_private')
+    assert target.__name__ == 'tlz.audit'
+    assert target.__package__ == 'tlz.audit'
+    assert target.__doc__ == 'fast docs'
+    assert target.__file__ == 'slow.py'
+    assert calls == ['cytoolz.audit', 'toolz.audit', 'tlz.audit.child']
